## Claims

- For incident patients in Denmark, the mean CHA2DS2-VASc score was 1.73 with a standard deviation of 1.07, median 2.00, minimum 0.00, and maximum 6.00 across 19,671 patients [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]], [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]])
- Region Hovedstaden had 5,241 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.66 [^src1] ([[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]])
- Sjælland had 3,202 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.82 [^src1] ([[sjaelland|Sjælland]])
- Syddanmark had 4,580 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.75 [^src1] ([[syddanmark|Syddanmark]])
- Midtjylland had 4,446 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.71 [^src1] ([[midtjylland|Midtjylland]])
- Nordjylland had 2,202 incident patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.75 [^src1] ([[nordjylland|Nordjylland]])
- Among incident female patients in Denmark, 39.79% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score <2 and 60.21% had a score ≥2 (n=8,209) [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]])
- Among incident male patients in Denmark, 45.18% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score <2 and 54.82% had a score ≥2 (n=11,462) [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]])
- For prevalent patients in Denmark, the mean age at diagnosis was 70 years with a standard deviation of 12, median 72, minimum 0, and maximum 104 across 134,810 patients [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]])
- Region Hovedstaden had 37,707 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 69 years [^src1] ([[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]])
- Sjælland had 21,755 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 70 years [^src1] ([[sjaelland|Sjælland]])
- Syddanmark had 31,541 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 71 years [^src1] ([[syddanmark|Syddanmark]])
- Midtjylland had 29,390 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 70 years [^src1] ([[midtjylland|Midtjylland]])
- Nordjylland had 14,417 prevalent patients with a mean age at diagnosis of 70 years [^src1] ([[nordjylland|Nordjylland]])
- For prevalent patients in Denmark, the mean CHA2DS2-VASc score was 1.47 with a standard deviation of 1.08, median 1.00, minimum 0.00, and maximum 6.00 across 134,810 patients [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]])
- Region Hovedstaden had 37,707 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.42 [^src1] ([[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]])
- Sjælland had 21,755 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.54 [^src1] ([[sjaelland|Sjælland]])
- Syddanmark had 31,541 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.52 [^src1] ([[syddanmark|Syddanmark]])
- Midtjylland had 29,390 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.44 [^src1] ([[midtjylland|Midtjylland]])
- Nordjylland had 14,417 prevalent patients with a mean CHA2DS2-VASc score of 1.48 [^src1] ([[nordjylland|Nordjylland]])
- Among prevalent female patients in Denmark, 14.19% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score of 0, 37.57% had a score of 1, and 31.01% had a score of 2 (n=56,112) [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]])
- Among prevalent male patients in Denmark, 22.37% had a CHA2DS2-VASc score of 0, 35.57% had a score of 1, and 25.74% had a score of 2 (n=78,698) [^src1] ([[danmark|Danmark]])
- Af den incidente population havde 22.148 patienter tilstrækkelig opfølgningstid (3 mdr.) til at indgå i indikatoropgørelsen [^src2] ([[indikator-2-ekkokardiografi]])
